text:
Ada: starting Constella LoRA merge into release/1.2.0-serving. Goal: quick merge sanity, nf4-int4 smoke, one experimental int3 probe, and a 24-example quickpack focused on payments + edge dates. @Ben can you export the prompts?
Ben: exporting CONSTELLA_prompts_120.csv -> constella_quick24.json. will scrub PII and bias to transactions + locale edgecases. uploading to s3 after scrub.
Hiro: after applying graft locally I noticed a subtle vocab shift around currency punctuation that impacts short templates. small diff: ```- token 1623: "$" -> 36
+ token 1623: "\u0024" -> 37``` Could cause leading-char drop in tiny outputs.
Rita: customer reported missing leading $ in invoices. We should not change base tokenizer. Plan: manifest token_remap + serving canonicalizer.
Ada: agree. Ben, include 3 adversarial currency/date cases in the quickpack. Keep pack <=24 so CI runs fast.
Ben: done. uploaded constella_quick24_v2.json to s3://redwood-evals/constella/quick24_v2.json with gold labels for amount/date/currency.
CI-Bot: CI job queued: run/eng-ml/constella-probe/3777770001.
CI-Bot: started on a100-40gb. config:
```yaml
model: constella-lora-v2
base: small-sage-7b
quant: nf4-int4
kv_cache: enabled
batch: 4
max_tokens: 48
evalpack: constella_quick24_v2.json
```
Sam: int4 first pass (24 examples): EM-fields fp16 0.94 -> int4 0.92, fluency 0.98 -> 0.96, P95 latency fp16 190ms -> int4 145ms, cost -36%. One case dropped cents.
Ada: good. kick int3 but experimental (kv_cache off). Tag results clearly.
CI-Bot: started int3 job (kv_cache: false).
Sam: int3 preliminary (first 10): EM 0.86, fluency 0.91, hallucinations 2/10 (fabricated amounts), P95 110ms. Will run full 24 and upload breakdown.
Hiro: I pushed a small manifest token_remap example: ```json
{"token_remap": {"37": 36}}
``` plus a unit test for canonical detokenize.
Rita: add a serving postprocess that normalizes currency tokens post-detokenize so fp16/int4/int3 are deterministic on templates. I'll add an assertion to smoke jobs.
Sam: full int3 done: EM 0.84, fluency 0.90, hallucinations 3/24. logs: /runs/3777770001/int3/logs.txt. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/constella/3777770001/artifacts.tar.gz
Ada: action items: (1) Ben finalize quickpack (done), (2) Hiro merge manifest remap + test, (3) Rita add serving canonicalizer + assertion, (4) Sam attach artifacts + cost delta. If int3 regressions remain high we'll ship int4 with route fallback to fp16 for payment endpoints.
Ben: added a small synthetic regression test for amount normalization to tests/evals/amount_norm_constella.py.
CI-Bot: run/eng-ml/constella-probe/3777770001 -> completed (status: WARN).
Ada: thanks team. I'll bundle remap + test + smoke CI in a small PR and gate canary on the amount_norm test. Closing once PRs green. :white_check_mark:
